Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.agent

Class Agent

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.observer.AbstractObservable
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.agent.Agent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observable, Observer, Serializable
public class Agent extends AbstractObservable implements Observer
A spectator moving through the concert-hall graph toward an exit.

An agent is either standing on a Node (currentEdge == null) or travelling along an Edge (with progressOnEdge in [0, 1]). Its AgentState drives its BehaviorStrategy: changing the state through setState(AgentState) swaps the strategy automatically. A state-independent strategy (such as LeaderFollowStrategy) can also be assigned with setStrategy(BehaviorStrategy).

The agent is Observable (it emits events when it changes state) and an Observer (it can react to events, keeping a personal history).

Version:
1.0
Author:
GROUPE E
